items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: I worked there for a couple of weeks... I came back to do this New Years Eve Party for Barney.

ctx.x: But Helen, Ellis used to hit the bottle a little bit too, didn't he? Didn't he take too many?
Are you kidding? You know, that's what Barney got mad at him for.
Yeah, I mean after all if you can't
